name: How long does a natural lighting upgrade project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a natural lighting upgrade project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a natural lighting upgrade varies depending on the scope and complexity of the project. A single sun tunnel installation might take a day or two, while multiple skylights or significant window replacements could extend to several days or even a week. Factors like weather conditions, existing structural elements, and necessary permits can influence the duration. We provide a detailed project schedule upfront, taking into account the specifics of your home in locations like Alameda or Berkeley, to set clear expectations for completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; a single sun tunnel can take a day or two, while multiple skylights or windows may take several days, influenced by project scope and weather.
